Name: Narcissus
Role: Head of a household in Rome
Summary: Narcissus is named only as the head of a household in Rome, and Paul greets those of his household who are in the Lord.
KeyStory: Narcissus is named only as the head of a household in Rome, and Paul greets those of his household who are in the Lord.
LifeLesson: The Lord knows his own even inside households that do not wholly believe.
